import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Preprocessing ---
# Fill missing 'Sleep Disorder' values
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder', inplace=True)

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Define a categorical order for BMI for better plotting
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set a visually appealing style and color palette
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="rocket")

# Create a 2x2 subplot grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Sleep and Health Metrics', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level, sized by Physical Activity
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(100, 400),
    alpha=0.8,
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    palette={'No Disorder': '#1f77b4', 'Sleep Apnea': '#d62728'}
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Disorder & Activity')

# Plot 2: Heart Rate Distribution by BMI Category and Sleep Disorder
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    dodge=True,
    s=12,
    linewidth=1.5,
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    palette={'No Disorder': '#1f77b4', 'Sleep Apnea': '#d62728'}
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Heart Rate by BMI and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12)

# Plot 3: Blood Pressure Analysis
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Systolic BP',
    y='Diastolic BP',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    style='BMI Category',
    s=200,
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    palette={'No Disorder': '#1f77b4', 'Sleep Apnea': '#d62728'}
)
# Add reference lines for hypertension stages (e.g., Stage 1: 130/80, Stage 2: 140/90)
axes[1, 0].axvline(140, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 0].axhline(90, color='grey', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
axes[1, 0].text(140.5, 78, 'Hypertension Stage 2', color='grey', rotation=90, verticalalignment='bottom')
axes[1, 0].text(124, 90.5, 'Hypertension Stage 2', color='grey', verticalalignment='bottom')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Blood Pressure by Disorder and BMI', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Systolic BP (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Diastolic BP (mmHg)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

# Plot 4: Daily Steps by Occupation
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='Occupation',
    y='Daily Steps',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    palette={'No Disorder': '#1f77b4', 'Sleep Apnea': '#d62728'},
    edgecolor='black'
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15)
for container in axes[1, 1].containers:
    axes[1, 1].bar_label(container, fmt='%d', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
